name: Gerald Brom
description: Gerald Brom , known professionally simply as Brom , is an American dark fantasy artist and illustrator born in 1965. Renowned for his "gothic-tribal" aesthetic, he rose to prominence in the late 1980s through his influential work for TSR , where he defined the visual identity of the Dark Sun campaign for Dungeons & Dragons . His career spans iconic contributions to video games (including Diablo , Doom II , and Hearthstone ), collectible card games like Magic: The Gathering , and major film productions. Beyond illustration, Brom is a celebrated author , creating richly illustrated novels such as The Child Thief , Krampus: The Yule Lord , and Slewfoot , in which he blends macabre horror with a tragic, elegant beauty.
